Selected work

Kannada historical fiction

Araṇyani

ಅರಣ್ಯನಿ

Set in the rainforests of the Western Ghats, Araṇyani follows communities defending their land and traditions under British rule.

In writing the novel, I drew on accounts of local resistance, the martial art of Kalarippayattu, regional traditions of worship and teachings from the Upanishads.

Publisher’s catalogueFind the book

Publication and reception

PM-YUVA selected 75 young authors from more than 16,000 proposals submitted across 22 languages. Araṇyani was the only Kannada title published by National Book Trust under that first programme.

National Book Trust launched the book at the New Delhi World Book Fair alongside the other PM-YUVA titles. My Kannada author profile reports sales of approximately 40,000 copies.
